purpose.zh: 练腰腹稳定，手脚动的时候腰不离地
purpose.en: Train your core to keep your lower back down while your arms and legs move.

text.zh: 下背贴地，一只手和另一侧的腿慢慢伸远
text.en: Keep your lower back down and slowly reach one arm and the other leg long

text.zh: 仰躺，双手指向天花板，髋和膝各弯成直角。
text.en: Lie on your back, arms pointing to the ceiling, hips and knees bent at right angles.

text.zh: 慢慢收回起始位，再换另一组手脚。
text.en: Return slowly to the start, then switch to the other arm and leg.

text.zh: 两边各做一次算 1 次。
text.en: One on each side counts as one rep.

commonErrors.en: Arching your lower back as your arm and leg reach out.
Swinging your arm and leg instead of moving with control.

cautions.zh: 腰拱起来时伸得近一点
cautions.en: If your lower back starts to arch, reach less far.

cautions.zh: 髋前面不舒服时腿放高一点
cautions.en: If the front of your hip feels uncomfortable, keep the leg higher.

changes: 动画左右轮流（先右手+左腿）→ unilateral=true、rep_alternate、剂量每侧 6 次（原 10 次未分侧）
节奏按 spec：伸 1.2 / 停 0.7 / 收 1.3 / 休 0.8 s
purpose 中英文不一致（中文只写「练腹部」）已统一；主口令去掉「对侧」；冒号式 cautions 改短句
轮流计数口径：一左一右算 1 次，剂量为每侧 N 次（reps=N），training.phases 描述一侧的一下，repUnit=left+right；startingSide=先动的一侧（right）
最终口径：按真实做法定（2026-11-01）
用户已定：改名、计时/计次、每侧/起始侧、计数单位按最终口径处理，相关待定项清除
